source_notes:
**Franchise:** PLUTO - 2023 anime adaptation  
**Strategy:** Squadron · **Target roster:** 6 robots  
**Opening:** 3 robots · **Hard cap:** 6 robots  
**Catalogue key:** `seven-great-robots-workshop`

**Proposed robots:** Gesicht; Brando; Hercules; Montblanc; North No.2; Epsilon.

**Source edition:** 2023 anime appearances: Gesicht, Brando, Hercules, Montblanc, North No.2, and Epsilon. Use Brando and Hercules in their established combat bodies; the other four retain their recognizable anime bodies.

**Naming:** All six are source characters. North No.2 is the valid arena spelling for source North #2. The stable name references the source group; the roster contains six, with Atom excluded to avoid repeating the earlier Astro Boy identity.

**Backstory:** A detective, two arena veterans, and three very different guardians enter a new competition. Six individuals share a workshop, but every body, temperament, and assignment remains distinct.

**Purchasing personality:** Montblanc joins Hercules to complete the second pair. North No.2 and Epsilon complete the final pair and second trio. Epsilon receives protective equipment and a high yield threshold as an explicit arena adaptation.

**Robot blueprints**

| Slot | Arena robot name | Source identity | Joins | Arena role | Loadout | Stance / yield | Build_Focus |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Gesicht** | Gesicht | Opening | Tactical line shooter | `single` | balanced / 20% | Tactician |
| 2 | **Brando** | Brando | Opening | Close-combat champion | `two_handed` | offensive / 10% | Bruiser |
| 3 | **Hercules** | Hercules | Opening | Protected champion | `weapon_shield` | defensive / 15% | Warden |
| 4 | **Montblanc** | Montblanc | Growth #1 | Durable line shooter | `two_handed` | balanced / 20% | Bruiser |
| 5 | **North No.2** | North #2 | Growth #2 | Heavy precision support | `two_handed` | balanced / 20% | Deadeye |
| 6 | **Epsilon** | Epsilon | Growth #3 | Protective anchor | `weapon_shield` | defensive / 40% | Tactician |

**Weapon paths** — stage 0 on recruitment, then stage 1. Prices are combined list-price equipment subtotals, not total robot or stable purchase costs.

| Slot | Range from weapons | Stage 0 | Stage 1 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | mid | Bolt Carbine (₡93,000) | Nova Caster (₡425,000) |
| 2 | melee | War Club (₡84,000) | Heavy Hammer (₡478,000) |
| 3 | short | Laser Pistol + Light Shield (₡108,000) | Volt Sabre + Aegis Bulwark (₡834,000) |
| 4 | mid | Training Rifle (₡50,000) | Plasma Cannon (₡408,000) |
| 5 | long | Training Beam (₡50,000) | Ion Beam (₡544,000) |
| 6 | short | Laser Pistol + Light Shield (₡108,000) | Volt Sabre + Aegis Bulwark (₡834,000) |

**Equipment planning totals:** opening trio ₡285,000; recruits 4–6 at stage 0 ₡208,000; all six at stage 1 ₡3,523,000; 8 equipped weapon/shield items at the six-robot target. The stage-0 equipment component of the slot-5-and-6 recruitment reserve is ₡158,000, plus both robot frames, required facilities, and maintenance reserve.

**Refinement plans — after all six robots reach stage 1**

Execute each row from left to right. Costs and workshop gates for every operation are in the [shared refinement rules](#squadron-refinement-rules). Main/offhand targets are explicit; all six robots have a non-empty plan.

| Slot | Robot | Ordered refinement steps | Refinement subtotal |
|---|---|---|---:|
| 1 | **Gesicht** | Main Nova Caster: Sharpen 1 (−10% cooldown) → Main Nova Caster: Forge 1 (+8% damage) | ₡700,000 |
| 2 | **Brando** | Main Heavy Hammer: Hone Hydraulic Systems 8→10 → Main Heavy Hammer: Augment Armor Plating +3 (new) → Main Heavy Hammer: Sharpen 1 (−10% cooldown) → Main Heavy Hammer: Forge 1 (+8% damage) | ₡920,000 |
| 3 | **Hercules** | Offhand Aegis Bulwark: Hone Evasion Thrusters −5→0 → Main Volt Sabre: Hone Combat Power 8→10 → Main Volt Sabre: Augment Adaptive AI +3 (new) → Main Volt Sabre: Sharpen 1 (−10% cooldown) → Main Volt Sabre: Forge 1 (+8% damage) | ₡1,170,000 |
| 4 | **Montblanc** | Main Plasma Cannon: Hone Combat Power 7→10 → Main Plasma Cannon: Hone Critical Systems 6→10 → Main Plasma Cannon: Augment Hull Integrity +3 (new) → Main Plasma Cannon: Sharpen 1 (−10% cooldown) → Main Plasma Cannon: Forge 1 (+8% damage) | ₡1,130,000 |
| 5 | **North No.2** | Main Ion Beam: Sharpen 1 (−10% cooldown) → Main Ion Beam: Forge 1 (+8% damage) | ₡700,000 |
| 6 | **Epsilon** | Offhand Aegis Bulwark: Hone Evasion Thrusters −5→0 → Main Volt Sabre: Hone Combat Power 8→10 → Main Volt Sabre: Augment Adaptive AI +3 (new) → Main Volt Sabre: Sharpen 1 (−10% cooldown) → Main Volt Sabre: Forge 1 (+8% damage) | ₡1,170,000 |

**Refinement budget:** ₡5,790,000 across six robots. Final stage-1 equipment plus refinement totals ₡9,313,000; stage-0 purchases and facility, frame, training, and maintenance costs are additional.

**Portrait blueprints** — show one complete body using the shared art direction. Signature features identify the source; every active weapon or shield must map to the equipment allocations above.

| Slot | Portrait and equipment brief |
|---|---|
| 1 | Anime Gesicht with his human-looking face, short hair, and detective clothing. One mid-range arena weapon; preserve the android's authentic appearance. |
| 2 | Use Brando's dark Pankration combat body rather than his everyday body. Preserve its source mass and mechanical head construction; one two-handed arena melee weapon. |
| 3 | Use Hercules's gold Pankration combat body and helmet head. One short-range arena weapon and one shield allocation; retain his distinction from Brando. |
| 4 | Preserve Montblanc's large pale cream-metal industrial body, blue overalls, and recognizable head. One heavy mid-range arena weapon; keep the full machine readable. |
| 5 | Use North #2's anime six-armed, legless hovering mechanical body and hooded cloak. One long-range two-handed weapon allocation; remaining arms are passive and create no extra equipment slots. |
| 6 | Preserve Epsilon's human-looking face, long platinum-blond/silver hair, and black anime clothing. Shield and sidearm are arena adaptations of a pacifist character, with no healing or solar-power mechanic. |

**Named teams and fixed membership** — all names are original Armoured Souls team labels.

| Format | Team name | Fixed members | Forms |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2v2 | **Detective and Champion** | 1 Gesicht + 2 Brando | Opening trio |
| 2v2 | **Mountain Guard** | 3 Hercules + 4 Montblanc | When slot 4 joins |
| 2v2 | **Sun and Steel** | 5 North No.2 + 6 Epsilon | When slot 6 joins |
| 3v3 | **Europol Vanguard** | 1 Gesicht + 2 Brando + 3 Hercules | Opening trio |
| 3v3 | **Quiet Guardians** | 4 Montblanc + 5 North No.2 + 6 Epsilon | When slot 6 joins |

**Shared parameters:** apply the Squadron recruitment, fixed-team, event-order, budget, tuning, refinement, and image rules below. Slots 1–3 open together; buy 4, then 5, then 6. No reserve slots or substitution alternatives are included.

References: [official anime identities and cast](https://media.netflix.com/en/only-on-netflix/81281344), [official anime production background](https://about.netflix.com/en/news/emotionally-charged-trailer-offers-a-thrilling-glimpse-into-the-pluto-anime).
purchasing_plan: Open with slots 1–3. Recruit slot 4, then fund the complete slot-5/slot-6 pair before buying 5 followed by 6. Finish all six final loadouts before refinement. Invest in slot order 1,4,2,5,3,6, with Hone, Augment, first Sharpen and first Forge passes through Workshop L1, L3, L5 and L8. Keep funding and prestige-gated steps pending.

equipment_budget.excludes: Frames, facilities, training, upkeep, repair costs, discounts and resale. Alternatives excluded.
